吴姜的眉头瞬间拧成了疙瘩，握着李月芽的手都紧了几分，周身的气息也跟着沉了下来。。

李月芽见他突然顿住脚步，连忙把埋在他肩膀上的脑袋抬起来，一双杏眼满是疑惑地盯着他，语气里带着几分怯意。

“怎么了？”

吴姜没急着回答，而是先从鬼差令牌里，将一块玉佩取了出来，挂在李月芽的脖子上。

玉佩通体透亮，表面还萦绕着一层淡淡的灵光，正是当初云市那个色鬼寄居过的那块，防御能力堪称顶尖。

做完这一切，他才沉声道：“我感知到念念的旁边还有一只鬼，不知道什么来头，这块玉佩可以防身，你千万别摘下来。”

说着，他又摸出几张叠得整整齐齐的黄符，塞进李月芽手里，让她装好，都是他平时画好的护身符。

一进鬼屋的时候，他就察觉到不对劲了。

鬼屋里的阴气有两股，其中一股，吴姜很熟悉，是念念的。另外一股，和念念在一起，实力比念念强了不止一个档次，已经达到了厉鬼顶峰的级别。

“这里有鬼？”李月芽眼睛倏地睁大，下意识地又将吴姜的胳膊抱得更紧，声音都微微发颤了。

吴姜拍了拍她的手背安抚：“你先退出鬼屋，在外面等我们，我去把念念带出来，很快就好。”

李月芽没有勉强，立刻点头答应了。

她心里清楚，留在这里，也是给吴姜当累赘。

可是，当两人往回退的时候，才发现，这操蛋的鬼屋，只能向前，不能后退。

无奈之下，只能带着李月芽一起向前走，单独将李月芽留在这里，别说李月芽不乐意了，他也不放心，还是跟在自己身边的好。

无数电视剧早就已经证明了，这种时候分开，那就是专门给反派送人头的。

吴姜揽着李月芽，顺着通道往前走着，前面不时的有黑影飘过，都是鬼屋精心设计的恐怖桥段，用来吓游客的。

Wu Jiang's brows instantly turned into knots, his hand holding Li Yueya's hand tightened a little, and the breath around him also sank..

Seeing that he suddenly stopped, Li Yueya quickly raised her head that was buried on his shoulder. She stared at him with a pair of almond-shaped eyes full of doubts, and her tone was a bit timid.

"What's wrong?"

Wu Jiang did not answer in a hurry, but first took out a jade pendant from the ghost token and hung it around Li Yueya's neck.

The jade pendant is completely translucent, with a faint aura lingering on the surface. It is exactly where the pervert once lived in Yun City, and its defensive capabilities are top-notch.

After doing all this, he said in a deep voice: "I sensed that there was a ghost next to Nian Nian. I don't know its origin. This jade pendant can be used for self-defense. Don't take it off."

As he spoke, he took out a few more neatly folded yellow talismans, put them into Li Yueya's hands, and asked her to put them in place. They were all talismans he usually drew.

As soon as he entered the haunted house, he noticed something was wrong.

There are two streams of Yin Qi in the haunted house, one of which Wu Jiang is very familiar with is Nian Nian.The other group, together with Nian Nian, is more than one level stronger than Nian Nian, and has reached the level of the peak Li Gui.

"Is there a ghost here?" Li Yueya's eyes widened suddenly, and she subconsciously hugged Wu Jiang's arm tighter, her voice trembling slightly.

Wu Jiang patted the back of her hand to comfort her: "Exit the haunted house first and wait for us outside. I'll take Nian Nian out. She'll be fine soon."

Li Yueya didn't force herself and immediately nodded in agreement.

She knew in her heart that staying here would also be a burden to Wu Jiang.

However, when the two of them stepped back, they realized that in this damn haunted house, you could only move forward, not backward.

In desperation, he could only take Li Yueya forward and leave Li Yueya here alone. Not to mention that Li Yueya was not happy, he was also worried, so it was better to stay with him.

Countless TV dramas have already proven that if you separate at this time, it's just to kill the villain.

Wu Jiang held Li Yueya in his arms and walked forward along the passage. From time to time, black shadows floated in front of him. They were all scary scenes carefully designed by the haunted house to scare tourists.
